messages.subject: Distance 7 Release
parts:
We would like to announce the release of Distance 7 Alpha.
 
With thanks to the Living Marine Resources Program for funding the development of Distance 7.
 
Living Marine Resource Program, US Navy,
Chief of Naval Operations, Energy and Environmental Readiness Division
N45, grant number N00244-10-1-0057
 
We would like to stress this is an alpha release, which means essentially that we are looking for guinea pigs.
 
The exciting additions to Distance 7 include the multi-analysis engine and the simulation engine. The multi-analysis engine allows you to incorporate unidentified sightings, covariate uncertainty and model uncertainty into your analyses. I am very keen to hear from anyone planning to use this functionality. The simulation engine allows you to test different designs for your specific study area and population of interest. Currently some of the more advanced options are not yet enabled in the interface but we will be working towards implementing these in the near future.
 
In addition we have updated the R library versions of mrds and dsm to the latest available and improved the display of R warnings to the user in the interface.
 
Please note that this version can happily be installed along side 6.2 (or older versions) and your distance files will NOT automatically be associated with version 7. On opening projects in version 7 you will be offered the opportunity to upgrade. Saving the upgraded project under a new name is advisable.
 
You will find a link to the installation at the following web address:
 
http://distancesampling.org/Distance/distance70download.html
 
Any issues can be reported via our issue tracker:
 
https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/distance-bugs/issues
 
Many thanks,
 
Laura

 
Dr. L. Marshall
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
